notifications.title: The Holy City held
notifications.body: The horde was beaten at its walls after 1 rounds.

notifications.title: A horde is at the Holy City
notifications.body: 9 of them against its guard of 30.

notifications.title: Boatwrights wait at (-4, 7)
notifications.body: Send them resources from your villages, and they build a boat that carries armies and caravans fast along the river, with a bounty of at least 2800 resources for everyone. If nobody does, the next horde from the south hates you the more.

notifications.title: The forbidding ruin at (1, -5) sank back into the earth
notifications.body: The next horde from the north hates you the more for it: +20% attack and defense.

notifications.title: Achievement: Palisade
notifications.body: Raise a fort in the field.

notifications.title: Fort at (-2, 3) finished
notifications.body: Armies holding it fight from behind its walls.

notifications.title: Captives are held at (-5, 9)
notifications.body: Clear the camp to free them before they are taken away, for a bounty of at least 2450 resources. If they are taken, the next horde from the south hates you the more.

notifications.title: The boatwrights at (4, 2) gave up and left
notifications.body: The next horde from the north hates you the more for it: +40% attack and defense.

notifications.title: A forbidding ruin rises at (1, -5)
notifications.body: Strong guardians watch it, and rich finds lie within, for a while. Searching it brings a bounty of at least 2100 resources; left alone, it rouses the next horde from the north.

notifications.title: The forbidding ruin at (-2, -5) sank back into the earth
notifications.body: The next horde from the north hates you the more for it: +20% attack and defense.

notifications.title: Boatwrights wait at (4, 2)
notifications.body: Send them resources from your villages, and they build a boat that carries armies and caravans fast along the river, with a bounty of at least 1750 resources for everyone. If nobody does, the next horde from the north hates you the more.

notifications.title: A forbidding ruin rises at (-2, -5)
notifications.body: Strong guardians watch it, and rich finds lie within, for a while. Searching it brings a bounty of at least 1400 resources; left alone, it rouses the next horde from the north.

notifications.title: Done: Raise a building
notifications.body: Claim its reward from the quest card.

notifications.title: The Builders' Barrow rises
notifications.body: The first builders sleep in the Builders' Barrow with their mark, the rune that bound the old span to Yav. Their dead still guard it: break through and bring the rune back, or no stone will hold the new span. It is marked on the map at (-4, -1).
